title: Data Locality Guard and Automated Evidence Rotator
creator: Sofia Martinez
description:
Problem: Customers who need auditable locality guarantees for Hosted API calls currently rely on manual exports and ad-hoc runbooks. We need a deterministic guard that enforces tenant-level locality constraints at request-routing time, plus a scheduled evidence rotator that packages and signs residency + retention proofs on a cadence suitable for compliance audits.

Goal: Deliver a combined feature set that (1) evaluates and enforces tenant pinsets (region/zone affinities) at the API edge, (2) surfaces soft/hard pin policies in Console and API, and (3) generates verifiable evidence bundles on schedule (daily/weekly/rolling) with retention metadata, cryptographic signatures, and export hooks. Focus is on Hosted API first; Dedicated/Private follow-ups are out of scope for this ticket.

Non-goals: Full enterprise legal attestations, on-prem offline proof-signing (separate project), and long-term archival storage implementation (we'll expose S3/Customer bucket export endpoints).
acceptance_criteria: API: Introduce new tenant-level residency policy object (policy_id) accessible via Console and API; policies must support modes: enforce-hard, enforce-soft, prefer-region, and ignore
Routing: Requests for tenants with enforce-hard must never route outside allowed regions — verified by integration test harness that simulates region failure and asserts fallback behavior
Console: Residency policy editor in Tenant Settings with preview simulation that shows current routing for a sample traffic mix

Evidence rotator: Scheduled job that produces bundled evidence (JSON manifest + signed metadata + per-endpoint routing snapshot) on configurable cadence (daily/weekly), stored in customer-configured export location

Export format: Evidence bundle must include: policy snapshot, list of routed endpoints with timestamps, retention profile applied, SHA256 hash and signature generated by our KMS; bundle schema v1 must be documented
Audit trails: Each policy change must create an immutable audit entry (who/when/what) visible in Console and exportable in the evidence bundle
Telemetry: New metrics exposed: policy_violation_count, evidence_bundle_created, evidence_export_failures; alerts for >0 policy_violation_count over 1h
Rollout: Feature flags to enable per-tenant; enablement gate in console with confirm modal and link to compliance docs
Docs: Confluence PRD, Console help articles, API spec changes, example signed evidence parsing snippet
Security: Security review completed and an internal KMS key scoped for evidence signing; threat model updated
notes: Design trade-off: start with region-level pins (e.g., us-west-2) rather than AZ-level to keep routing complexity lower; we may expand to geo-fences later
We should reuse existing residency manifest structure from PM-40211 but introduce a generation timestamp and signature block
Retention profiles are mapped to evidence lifecycle; rotator only packages evidence — archival/long-term storage delegated to export targets (customer S3 or Redwood archive bucket)
For enforce-soft mode: route preference should attempt in-region first, then fall back to nearest allowed region, but write a telemetry event tagged as soft-violation when fallback occurs
Design note for UX: add a simulation toggle in the policy editor that replays a 24h synthetic traffic sample and highlights the percentage of requests that would be out-of-region
Plan to include a small sample verifier utility (python) in docs to validate bundle signatures using our public verification key
tasks: PM: finalize policy API schema and update tenant settings wireframes
Design: new residency policy editor + simulation view (low-fidelity prototypes complete)
ENG: routing guard at edge + integration tests for failover scenarios
ENG: evidence rotator service with KMS signing and export adapters (S3, GCS, HTTP webhook)
ENG: telemetry + alerts + Console wiring for audit entries
Security/Compliance: run security review and legal sign-off on evidence contents
risks: Incorrect routing decisions could cause data to be processed outside of contractual obligations — mitigated by enforce-hard mode and integration tests
Evidence export failures could leave customers without audit artifacts — we will retry exports and surface failures in Console and via webhook
KMS key management must be careful; avoid key reuse across tenants without scoping — Security to propose key scoping model
qa_approach: Unit tests for policy evaluation logic (enforce-hard/soft/preference)
Integration tests that spin up multi-region routing simulator and assert no cross-region routing when enforce-hard is set
E2E: enable feature flag for a test tenant, run synthetic traffic, verify evidence bundle contains correct routing snapshots and signatures
Manual compliance review: provide sample bundles to Compliance team for verification
rollout_plan: Alpha: internal tenants only (flag: residency.guard.alpha) — 2 weeks
Beta: selected customers (opt-in via Support) with feedback loop — 4 weeks
GA: broad console rollout + API docs; gated on security review and <1% evidence export failure rate over 7 days
